metadata.description: Local-first tools that put you and your AI in charge of your own accounts and data.

plugins.name: skillbooks
plugins.description: Every book read is a stat permanently raised. Your agent picks these up for good: mail a human would send, drafts that survive a cold reader, claims traced to their source, code swept for what a refactor left behind and for problems solved twice, and the judgment to know which decisions are truly yours.

plugins.name: magazines
plugins.description: Claude Code skills for unattended web work: read and act on your logged-in sites, return structured tables and source-cited dossiers, from a terminal, a server, or a schedule.

plugins.name: holotapes
plugins.description: The Overseer's personal tapes: the agent stops guessing, verifies before it fixes, prevents bugs instead of farming them. Not opt-in, and no fun at all. Traditionally looted off the Overseer's corpse; he'd rather you file an issue to ask for access.
